login.headline: One APAAR ID. One verifiable academic record.
login.description: ChhatraLekha validates every enrolment as it is uploaded, detects regulatory breaches before they reach the national registry, and issues credentials that any employer can check with a signed, expiring, revocable token.
login.featureImpact: Change impact detection before a correction is applied
login.featureToken: Opaque verification tokens - no raw APAAR ID in a URL
login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Use the account issued to you by the AICTE Directorate or your institution.
login.googleRestricted: A first-time Google sign-in creates an account with the restricted verifier role.
login.demo: Demo accounts are created by the seed script. Their password is read from DEMO_PASSWORD, or generated and printed once at seed time.

dashboard.title: AICTE Directorate dashboard
dashboard.lead: Sanctioned intake against actual enrolment, with supernumerary ceilings, duplicates and the programme-level compliance matrix already worked out.
dashboard.quotaLead: Enrolment against the sanctioned seats of every quota bucket
dashboard.riskLead: Every contributing anomaly family is listed, so the score is explainable
dashboard.noRisk: No institution currently carries an anomaly.
dashboard.matrixLead: Every institution against its sanctioned intake

students.title: Student register
students.lead: Every enrolment record the registry holds, with the APAAR ID masked unless the full identifier is needed.
students.notFoundLead: Adjust the filters, or upload a batch to add enrolments.

institutions.title: Institutions
institutions.lead: Every AICTE-approved institution in the registry, together with the sanctioned capacity of each programme.
institutions.selectLead: Select an institution to see its programmes.
institutions.noneSelectedLead: Pick one on the left to list its approved programmes.

anomalies.title: Anomaly inspector
anomalies.lead: Every finding carries a rule code, a severity, an explanation and a recommended next step. An anomaly is an indication for investigation, not proof of fraud.
anomalies.nothingLead: No finding matches the current filters. That is good news.

verify.title: Verify an APAAR credential
verify.lead: The verdict is always issued. Personal fields are disclosed only when the student has consented to credential verification.
verify.noResultLead: Enter an APAAR ID or scan a badge to see the signed verdict.
verify.withheldLead: The student has not consented to credential verification, or has withdrawn it. The verdict above is still issued.
verify.prototypeLead: This page resolves an opaque verification token against this prototype's own database.
verify.tokenFailed: The token could not be checked.
verify.nothingLead: The link is missing its token.
verify.cameraUnsupported: This browser does not expose a camera. Use the APAAR ID field instead.
verify.cameraDenied: Camera access was refused. Use the APAAR ID field instead.

reports.title: Regulatory reports
reports.lead: Download the registers the AICTE Directorate and regional offices ask for. Every export is written to the audit trail.
reports.failed: The report could not be generated.
reports.auditLead: The most recent entries of the hash-chained trail.
reports.auditText: The full trail is available as a CSV export above - it carries the chain hashes, so an auditor can re-verify it offline.

about.label: Academic identity and verification
about.headline: A trusted digital academic identity for every student
about.intro: ChhatraLekha (छात्रलेखा) helps institutions keep student records accurate, helps students carry their achievements with them, and gives employers and other institutions a simple, privacy-respecting way to check that a credential is genuine. Authenticate. Verify. Empower.
about.notice: ChhatraLekha is a prototype. It runs on synthetic demonstration data, and checks made on this site are not official APAAR, AICTE, UGC, ABC or DigiLocker verification.
about.problem1Desc: Student data is often entered by hand and reconciled in batches, so errors, duplicates, and mismatches build up unnoticed.
about.problem2Title: Credentials that are hard to trust.
about.problem2Desc: A paper or PDF certificate is easy to alter, and checking one usually means writing to the institution and waiting.
about.problem3Desc: Confirming a credential should not require revealing a student's personal details.
about.step1Desc: Institutions enrol students and each student receives an identity linked to their institution and programme.
about.step2Desc: Records are uploaded in bulk or one at a time, and each is checked as it arrives.
about.step3Desc: Automated rules flag malformed identifiers, duplicate enrolments, seat-limit breaches, and unusual changes, with a reason for every flag.
about.step4Desc: An authorised administrator reviews flagged items and decides. People make the final decision, not the software.
about.step5Desc: Approved credentials carry a QR code. Scanning it shows whether the credential is valid, expired, or revoked.
about.offer1Desc: A digital ID with a QR code the student controls. (planned; see roadmap)
about.offer2Desc: See which credentials and records a correction would affect before it is applied.
about.offer3Desc: Rule-based checks with clear, explainable reasons for every alert.
about.offer4Desc: Valid, expired and revoked states, checked against the live record.
about.offer5Desc: Every important action is recorded in a hash-linked log that exposes later changes.
about.offer6Desc: The interface is available in 13 Indian languages, with light and dark themes.
about.privacy1: Public verification pages show only the institution, programme, academic year and status. They never show a name, a date of birth, or an APAAR ID.
about.privacy2: Verification links use random, unguessable tokens that can expire and be revoked.
about.privacy3: Access is limited by role: students, institution staff, verifiers, and administrators each see only what they need.
about.privacy4: Credentials are digitally signed, and the signing key is held on the server.
about.privacy5: Demonstration data is entirely synthetic. No real student records are used.
about.not1: It is not an official government system and is not connected to APAAR, AICTE, UGC, ABC or DigiLocker.
about.not2: It does not replace an institution's own decisions. Software flags records; authorised people approve them.
about.not3: Offline verification on the Android app is limited. It cannot know about a revocation made after the device last synced.
about.contactLead: Use the contact page and the maintainers will get back to you.
